name: gizza-ai/stream-editor
summary: Apply sed-style edit scripts to pasted text

tool.description: Apply a safe ed/sed-style command script to pasted text in one pass. Supports line/regex addresses, ranges, substitutions, delete, print, insert/append/change text, transliteration, labels/branches, hold-space commands, line numbers and list output. Filesystem and shell sed commands are intentionally unavailable in the sandbox. Use quiet=true for sed -n behaviour, regex_flavor=extended for sed -E syntax, whole_buffer=true for multi-line edits, and max_output_lines as a safety cap.

ignore_case.description: Make every regex address and substitution pattern case-insensitive. Default false.

line_ending.description: Output line ending: lf (Unix, default) or crlf (Windows).

max_output_lines.description: Safety cap on emitted output lines. Default 100000.

quiet.description: Suppress automatic printing like sed -n; only explicit p/P/= /l commands emit output. Default false.

regex_flavor.description: Regex syntax for script patterns: basic (sed/BRE style, default) or extended (sed -E style).

script.description: ed/sed-style command script. Supports addresses (line numbers, $, /regex/, ranges), s/// substitutions, d/D delete, p/P print, i/a/c text, y transliteration, labels and branches, hold-space commands, q/Q quit, = line numbers and l list.

text.description: Input text to edit. The script is applied line-by-line by default, similar to sed's pattern-space cycle.

whole_buffer.description: Treat the entire input as one pattern space instead of one line per cycle. Useful for multi-line substitutions. Default false.
